page.layout: One page of text: running head at the top with the page number at the top right; below it a continuing paragraph of text, then the centred word "FINIO." in spaced capitals; below that a woodcut ornament, no text.

main_text.p: dederit, quodque, uti incipere, ita & finire largitus fuerit. Faxit ille, ut inferviat luæ gloriæ, Ecclesiæ ædificationi & meæ[?] saluti; quo voto

page.notes: The page ends with a woodcut ornament (fruit, leaves and ribbons in a cartouche) below "FINIO.", not transcribed. "mee" may be "meæ"; the æ-ligature is hard to make out. The running head is printed as "Operis conclusio·" with a middle dot. The top line is treated as running head followed by a continuing paragraph.
